name: kit-extra
about: LumaKit with an extra player (M-045). kit-extra on EggStarGalaxy makes a second player (kit.player.character second_player, svc.player), then: kit.area's orderCube (kit-area's layer) entered by player 1 alone gives one enter and one inside call a frame, never with the extra player; a kit.gravity override of 60 frames lives 60 frames; a mod's kit.player.form form on player 1 still holds after the extra player takes a Fire Flower. Before the fix each hook acted per MarioActor: 40 inside calls, 30 frames, the form ended.
